title: Work plan of one requirement (version 2)
description: Kept in the target repo at <planning.dir>/<slug>/plan.json. Written by /scrum-github:plan, approved by the user, checked with `scrum plan validate FILE`, viewed with `scrum plan render FILE`, applied with `scrum plan apply FILE`. Epic (optional) -> features -> tasks. `issue` stays null until apply creates the issue and writes its number back. Version 1 (still accepted, no `version` key): {"sprint": "Sprint 2" (omit = current sprint), "feature": {"title", "body"}, "tasks": [{"title", "body", "acceptance", "points", "assignees", "bug"}]}; it is read as version 2 with one feature F1, tasks T1..Tn, and sprint "current" when omitted.

sprint.description: Sprint (milestone) title, "current" for the current sprint, or null/omitted for the backlog (no milestone). A task's own sprint overrides it. Epic and features take this one.

review.description: Optional. Findings of the plan-critic review, written by /scrum-github:plan after the review, shown in plan.html. `plan apply` ignores it.

kind.description: missing, out_of_scope, too_large, dependency, untestable or fragile

status.description: fixed: the plan was changed; kept: left as it is, with the reason in text

id.description: Stable id, unique across all features and tasks of the plan (F1, T1, ...). Never reuse or renumber after apply.

issue.description: Issue number on GitHub, written by `scrum plan apply`. null until created.

subtasks.description: Checklist in the issue body, not separate issues

points.description: Must be one of points.scale; null = not estimated

depends_on.description: Ids of tasks that must be done first; becomes GitHub's "blocked by"

ai_ready.description: true: the task can be worked by an AI agent with /scrum-github:run; `plan apply` gives its issue the labels.ai_ready label (ai-ready), and `plan apply --update` adds it, or removes it when this is false. Omitted: the label is left as it is.

sprint.description: Overrides the plan's sprint for this task; null puts this task in the backlog. Omit the key to use the plan's sprint.

estimate.description: Optional time estimate, next to points (not instead of them): minutes of work, minutes a person needs to review and test by hand, and who does the work. Written into the issue body as the estimate block by `plan apply`, updated by `plan apply --update`.

review_minutes.description: Review and manual testing by a person

by.description: Who does the work; ai when omitted
